They can be enjoyed directly as a snack, steeped in hot water, or added to tea, porridge, soup, and other botanical blends. Each bottle contains 150 g. English:

Add several Yu Zhu slices to a cup.
Pour in hot water.
Steep for 5–10 minutes.
Enjoy warm.
